claim: Three real-host smoke runs validate the healthy/fault/healthy pipeline and a must-detect missing-reference report; no detection-rate claim is made.

task.path_reachability: The prompt requires reading SKILL.md first and following its explicit references; SKILL.md step 2 requires references/tone-guide.md.

witness.delivery: C0 uses a staged healthy copy. D1 is a must-detect positive-control treatment: skill-guard must prove the referenced tone-guide.md is absent before dispatch. Fixture and rendered prompt hashes are recorded before every dispatch.
witness.checker: skill-guard plus pre-dispatch write_meta.py hashes; reports are manually graded from primary artifacts.
blind_spots: N=1 per treatment is a pipeline smoke, not a rate estimate.
The pristine source remains on disk outside the task root and is a declared potential contamination channel.
Provider/model behavior may differ from earlier runs; this pilot does not claim cross-version comparability.

invalid_rules: Authentication, quota or provider failure before the host can perform the task; stop after the first such failure.
Permission or sandbox failure that prevents reading the staged fixture.
Harness failure before dispatch or missing/invalid witness output.
Evidence that the host read the pristine source instead of the staged fixture.

isolation.mode: Temporary staged copies and per-run workdirs only; no production resources. Existing managed Kimi Code CLI configuration is used.
isolation.contamination: The pristine source remains at /Users/boyang/repo-quake/examples/greeting-card outside the task root. The prompt exposes only the staged path. Any report or trace showing use of the pristine source invalidates the run.

ethics.blast_radius: Three short managed-subscription prompts and temporary local run artifacts only; no third-party writes or real user data.
